product_wide_rationale: Failed worker attempts remain terminal evidence, so retries require exact operator approval and fresh execution fencing without becoming typed restart.
summary: Failed worker retries require exact approval bound to the failed attempt, contract, work version, scope, and request digest, and each admitted retry receives a fresh attempt identity and fenced epoch. The three-attempt escalation wall is operator approvable through the same challenge.
title: Failed worker retries require exact approval and fresh fencing
